cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only holding the wedding ribbon. Could you pinch these bouquet stems together while I choose where the bow goes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got them. They need wire underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, we'll put it under your fingers. Could you just twist this piece round? I'll keep the ribbon out of your way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There. The sharp end will snag the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you tuck that in and wind the ribbon over it? A little bow on this side would hide the join. I'll hold the scissors while you finish it.

reason: Replace generic S06 tags with modest participation and actual outcome choices, keeping the precise Drive and B responsive contributions. Perform a further saved-dialogue reread before writer readiness.
